company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Turun Thermohuolto Oy — reliable service since 2004.
company.historyP1: We started operations on March 1, 2004 in the Oriketo district of Turku. Our specialty is vehicle air conditioning systems, refrigeration units and auxiliary heaters.
company.historyP2: Today we operate from our facilities in Tuulissuo, Lieto, completed in autumn 2010.
company.historyP3: On March 1, 2024, we celebrated our 20th anniversary. Warm thanks to all our customers for their trust and loyalty, and to our partners for their cooperation!
company.missionP1: Turun Thermohuolto Oy is a legally responsible refrigeration company specializing in the installation, repair and maintenance of vehicle refrigeration units. We also serve as a distribution point for refrigeration equipment.
company.missionP2: As authorized by the authorities, we perform testing and calibration activities for transport containers of perishable goods. We serve in all matters relating to the safe transport of frozen and fresh goods.
company.qualityP1: Customer needs and service are important development areas for us. We maintain competence to international testing and calibration laboratory standards.
company.qualityP2: Quality objectives are set in cooperation with staff and their achievement is continuously monitored. Continuous improvement is a key part of our management system.
company.staffP1: Our staff is committed to following operational guidelines and maintaining their professional skills. Continuous training and identifying development needs is everyone's responsibility.
company.milestone2: Move to new facilities in Tuulissuo, Lieto

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: A comprehensive range of vehicle refrigeration units, auxiliary heaters and air conditioning systems from all major brands.

refrigeration.title: Refrigeration Units
refrigeration.description: Installation, maintenance and repair of all branded refrigeration units — quickly and professionally. Brands we represent: Thermo King, Lumikko, Carrier, Frigoblock, Hultsteins and Mitsubishi.

heating.title: Auxiliary Heaters
heating.description: Sales, installation, maintenance and repair of Webasto and Eberspächer auxiliary heaters. Autumn maintenance services and preventive upkeep.

ac.title: Air Conditioning
ac.description: Installation, maintenance and repair of AC systems. Authorized service for MB, Setra, EvoBus, Finnotzo, Sutrak and Konvekta. Now also stocking R-1234YF refrigerant.

atp.title: ATP Seasonal Inspections
atp.description: The Finnish Food Authority has authorized us to perform ATP seasonal inspections of food transport containers. We verify the structural classification eligibility of transport vehicles six years and older.

boatsMotorhomes.title: Boats & Motorhomes
boatsMotorhomes.description: Installation, repair and maintenance of heaters for boats and motorhomes. Authorized Webasto and Eberspächer dealer. All sizes of motor and sailing boats.

tractors.title: Tractors & Equipment
tractors.description: Installation, maintenance and repair of heaters and air conditioning systems for tractors and work machines.

electrical.title: Vehicle Electrical Work
electrical.description: Automotive electrical work including waste compactors and tailgates. Versatile vehicle electrical expertise.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: We represent and sell leading refrigeration, heater and air conditioning brands.
products.usedEquipmentDesc: We occasionally have used refrigeration units and spare parts available. Ask about availability!
products.pipeRepairDesc: Air conditioning pipe repair using the VULCAN Lockring method. Repair of rear evaporator pipes in vans and minibuses without removing pipes from the chassis. A fast, durable and cost-effective alternative to pipe replacement.
